summary: Iteration 2 end-to-end review of pendants + roadmap + alert escalation/close-out + resident AI personalization. Expanded pytest suite from 32 -> 46 tests; 46/46 PASS. Verified route ordering: /alerts/stats is NOT clobbered by /alerts/{alert_id}. Verified seeded data: 34 roadmap items across phases 1-5, 7 pendants with resident_name attached. Public /api/pendants/event end-to-end: press creates pendant-triggered alert with resident_name, periodic_ping does NOT create alert, unknown frequency -> 404 + logged to pendant_unknown. AlertClose flow saves outcome/close_notes and timeline returns Created/Acknowledged/Resolved entries. Frontend verified with Playwright as admin: 6 tabs render, Roadmap (34 items / 5 phases) status+notes edits save, Pendants tab lists 7, Register + Simulate press dialogs fire and alerts appear in Staff dashboard, Residents Edit pre-fills preferred_name/participation_level/preferences/memory, AlertDetailDialog opens with timeline and close-out submits (Event closed toast). 10 escalation badges render in Staff dashboard.

minor.issue: Public ingest is unauthenticated/unsigned; any client can inject alerts by guessing a registered frequency. Add HMAC/device_token validation in production.
AlertClose model does not require outcome server-side; frontend enforces it, but backend accepts empty outcome silently. Consider Field(min_length=1) on outcome.

Lazy escalation only bumps level for alerts in status=='active'. Once a staffer acknowledges, escalation stops — correct in design, but once resolved, previously escalated alerts' escalation_level remains in history for auditing (good). Not a bug, just documenting.

issues: Tab list shows '(0)' count while data loads — harmless flicker; could show a skeleton or suppress counts until fetch resolves.
Escalation badge uses same amber for LV1 and LV3 in the sample rendered — consider distinct colors (amber→orange→red) to emphasize severity of unacked time.

action_items: (Optional) Enforce outcome min_length=1 on AlertClose server-side for parity with UI validation.
(Optional) Add device_token/HMAC check on /api/pendants/event before production rollout.
(Optional) Differentiate LV1/LV2/LV3 escalation badge colors on Staff dashboard.
critical_code_review_comments: alerts.py: /stats is correctly declared BEFORE /{alert_id} (regression-tested). Keep this ordering or migrate to explicit path on /stats.
pendants.py: create_pendant rejects duplicate frequency but does NOT reject duplicate pendant_id serial label — consider uniqueness on pendant_id too.
pendants.py: /event endpoint updates battery/signal and creates alert atomically but without a transaction — acceptable for MVP, flag if multi-doc consistency matters later.
roadmap.py: PATCH filters None values but does not validate that status transitions make sense (e.g., done->blocked allowed). Acceptable for admin-only tool.
seed.py (not read this iteration): 34 roadmap items + 7 pendants confirmed via API; seed idempotency assumed from prior iteration. No new seed bugs observed.
seed_data_creation: Auto-seeded on startup: 34 roadmap items across phases 1-5, 7 pendants (several with resident_name joined), residents with preferred_name/preferences/memory/participation_level populated. Test suite also creates TEST_-prefixed residents/pendants/staff and cleans them up.
context_for_next_testing_agent: Backend regression suite at /app/backend/tests/backend_test.py covers 46 tests in ~14s including Claude chat, OpenAI TTS, pendant event ingest, roadmap CRUD, alert close-out/timeline. participation_level is a strict Literal: 'room_only'|'pendant_enhanced'|'wearable_enhanced'|'family_connected'|'full' — do not send free-form strings. Route ordering in alerts.py: /stats BEFORE /{alert_id} is required and currently correct.
rca_of_the_issue: N/A — no regressions found. One test authoring miss (used 'active' for participation_level) was self-corrected to 'pendant_enhanced' per Literal definition.
